project.name: West Coast Hip-Hop Minimal Aggressive Club Energy

arrangement.notes: Arrangement uses minimal variations with aggressive and club energy profile. Sample layer uses modern sample chopping techniques.

event_markers.label: Slice Start
event_markers.reason: Beginning of modern sample chopping pattern for drums

event_markers.label: Minimal Chop
event_markers.reason: Introduce minimal variation in bass sample slices

event_markers.label: Chop Stutter
event_markers.reason: Apply stutter chopping technique on chords in hook

event_markers.label: Glitch Chop
event_markers.reason: Use glitch chop sample technique for melody variation

event_markers.label: Vocal Slice Retrigger
event_markers.reason: Retrigger vocal samples with chopping technique in final hook

event_markers.label: Reversed Sample Chop
event_markers.reason: Use reversed chopping technique for FX in outro

track_roles.drums: rhythmic foundation with modern sample chops
track_roles.bass: sub bass layer with minimal sample slicing
track_roles.chords: textural support using chopped stutter effects
track_roles.melody: lead lead lines with glitch-style sample chops
track_roles.fx: atmospheric effects via reversed sample chops

sensei_drum.brief: Create aggressive drum patterns using modern sample chopping techniques suitable for West Coast hip-hop with club energy.

bass_generator.brief: Generate minimal bass sample slices emphasizing groove and aggressive club feel.

harmony_generator.brief: Add chopped chord samples using stutter and slice effects to enhance texture and complement the mood.

melody_generator.brief: Produce melody lines using glitch-style sample chopping techniques to maintain minimal variation and aggression.

ai_designer.brief: Oversee arrangement energy profile ensuring minimal variations and maintaining aggressive, club energy mood.

presetor.brief: Apply presets that emphasize clear, punchy sample chop effects for each channel named after chopping techniques.

songgps.brief: Control track activity and section energy to match the arrangement curve and mood specifications.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Prepare routing and mix settings to keep sample chop clarity and maintain aggressive club energy balance.
